newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson keeps FMC at buy.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson keeps FMC at buy.

text.p: Dresdner Bank Kleinwort Benson Research on Wednesday reiterated its "buy" recommendation for shares in Fresenius Medical Group (FMC), the dialysis subsidiary of German medical group Fresenius.

"We had a buy recommendation on FMC and we have kept that. The valuations are unchanged. The share price should go to around 35 dollars for the ADS (American Depositary Shares) and that sounds like a buy," Stephan Putnam, chemical analyst at Dresdner Bank Kleinwort Benson Research, told Reuters.
Shares in the parent Fresenius AG remain on hold, Putnam said.
FMC shares were up 7.90 marks, or 5.33 percent, at 156 marks in late IBIS DAX electronic trade, while preference shares in Fresenius were up 17.50 marks, or 4.86 percent, at 377.50 marks.
